title: China Perils
text:
China Perils

The following table lists the perils and peril codes that 
Touchstone
 supports for China.

| Import peril code | Peril | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PAL | All licensed perils | |
| PES | Earthquake shake only | |
| PPH | Precipitation flood | |
| PWA | All wind perils | Winter storm sub-peril is valid for U.S. exposures only. |
| PWH | Typhoon only | |

rows: Winter storm sub-peril is valid for U.S. exposures only.
